comparisonMatrix: Product fit
Which product category, size and weight will the package hold?
Product dimensions, product weight, fit tolerance, product category and protection needs
Sales channel
Where will the packaging be used?
Retail shelf, e-commerce shipping, distributor packing, marketplace fulfillment, gifting or mixed route
Structure choice
Which structure should be compared first?
Rigid gift box, folding carton, paper tube, cosmetic box, PVC/PET clear box, corrugated mailer or insert set
Brand expression
What should the package communicate?
Surface finish direction, material direction, color reference, artwork status and unboxing expectation
Sampling purpose
What should the sample prove?
Structure fit, material comparison, visual direction, insert support or pre-production review
Destination review
What documents or market checks are needed?
Buyer-supplied destination-market document requests for project-by-project review
RFQ readiness
Is the inquiry ready for supplier review?
Quantity direction, timeline target, artwork files, reference photos, packing route and delivery destination
